neutral.graph_Gauss_derivation: Native U links run1->0, with G0=Q0+L_tree+L_cycle and G1=Q1+R_tree+R_cycle. Tree U=I gives R_tree=-(Q1+R_cycle), L_tree=Q1+R_cycle. Thus G1=0 operator identity, G0=globalG, E_tree(0->1)=Q1+R_cycle. Full Q1^2 and Q1-R cross terms include all intermediate masks, not (P Q1 P)^2.

local_continuity_operator_defect.meaning: Raw graph identity dot rho0=-sum_e J_e. The BAND-pair projection does not commute physical-site density, so these measured defects must not be suppressed or called exact projected Ward conservation.
